services.name: Water audit
services.blurb: Catch cups on the lawn, a pressure reading at every valve, and a written report.

services.name: Sprinkler repair
services.blurb: Each fault listed with its zone, its part and its price before any digging.

services.name: Nozzle upgrade
services.blurb: Old spray nozzles swapped for low-flow rotary nozzles that soak in instead of running off.

services.name: Drip irrigation
services.blurb: Drip lines for shrubs, trees and raised beds, with a pressure regulator and filter.

services.name: Lawn to drip conversion
services.blurb: Thirsty lawn strips turned into drip-watered planting beds, one zone at a time.

services.name: Smart controller setup
services.blurb: Controller installed, zones named, and run times set from your audit numbers.

services.name: Leak detection
services.blurb: Meter test first, then zone by zone until the leak is found and marked.

services.name: Pressure regulation
services.blurb: Misting heads and popping fittings fixed by bringing the water pressure into range.

services.name: Backflow testing
services.blurb: Annual backflow test with the reading and the paperwork ready for your water agency.

services.name: New sprinkler system
services.blurb: A new system designed from a site measure, with the head layout drawn before work starts.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: The catch cups showed one side of the front lawn getting almost twice the water of the other. They moved two heads and changed the nozzles. Our bill dropped the next cycle.
reviews.name: Hector A.

reviews.text: I liked the printed list: zone, problem, part, price. I said yes to four items and no to two, and nobody pushed.
reviews.name: Janet W.

reviews.text: Pressure at our house read way too high and the heads were misting into the wind. A regulator fixed it in about an hour. Should have done it years ago.
reviews.name: Tom B.

reviews.text: Meter was spinning with everything off. They tracked it to a cracked fitting under the walkway and patched it through one small cut instead of pulling up the whole path.
reviews.name: Mei L.

reviews.text: Converted the parkway strip to drip with lavender and sage. The runoff onto the sidewalk is gone and the plants are filling in faster than I expected.
reviews.name: Sandra G.

reviews.text: Backflow test was booked for a Tuesday morning window and they showed up at the start of it. Test done, reading written down, form handled, about twenty minutes total.
reviews.name: Phil N.

reviews.text: Renee set the controller from the audit numbers instead of guessing. Every zone has its own run time now, and the dry corner by the driveway finally filled in.
reviews.name: Alicia F.

proof.guarantee: Every repair we list and price is covered for one year, parts and labor.
